title: Custom Built-In Wardrobe & Bedroom Storage
subtitle: Custom fitted bedroom wardrobes with soft-close hinges and sliding doors
author: Bouul Carpentry Team
problemHeadline: Stock wardrobes waste space and fail to fit non-standard ceiling heights
problemBody: Off-the-shelf furniture leaves awkward dust-collecting gaps and lacks custom shelving options.
bouulSolution: Custom design, precision cutting, and professional installation of built-in cupboards
Choice of MelaWood, SupaWood, or solid timber finishes with soft-close hardware
Escrow holds 50% deposit until installation is 100% complete and level
aiPromptExample: Request wardrobe quote: '3-meter wall-to-wall built-in cupboard with sliding mirror doors in Bryanston.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: 3m x 2.4m MelaWood BIC, 6 drawers, double hanging rails. Escrow Quote: R9,800.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon door alignment, smooth track motion, and site cleanup.
pirbStandard: Institute of Timber Construction (ITC-SA) & SANS 10082 Carpentry Standards.

articleSections.heading: Precision Laser Level Alignment
articleSections.body: Carpenters utilize 360° laser levels to ensure plumb cabinet carcasses even on uneven floors.

articleSections.heading: Edge Banding Durability
articleSections.body: Impact-resistant 2mm PVC edging is applied to drawer fronts for long-lasting wear.

title: Solid Wood Door Hanging & Lock Fitting
subtitle: Precision fitting, planing, and hanging of interior and exterior solid doors
author: Bouul Carpentry Team
problemHeadline: Ill-fitting doors rub against frames, stick during humid weather, or leak drafts
problemBody: Hanging heavy hardwood doors requires precise mortising that amateur DIY ruined.
bouulSolution: Master carpenter trims, mortises, and hangs solid hardwood or hollow-core doors
Includes rebate cutting for weather-stripping and precision mortise lock installation
Escrow protection released after testing smooth latching and zero frame drag
aiPromptExample: Book door hanging: 'Hang 3 new solid Meranti internal doors including lock fitting.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Trim 3 doors to size, mortise 3x hinges per door, install mortise locks. Escrow: R1,800.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after testing smooth swing and latch engagement.

articleSections.heading: Seasonal Expansion Trimming
articleSections.body: Carpenters calculate 2mm expansion gaps to ensure doors don't stick during humid summer months.

articleSections.heading: Ball-Bearing Hinge Support
articleSections.body: Heavy solid wood doors are hung with 3 triple-ball-bearing brass hinges for silent operation.

title: Wooden Deck Construction & Balau Restoration
subtitle: Custom hardwood outdoor decking, balustrades, and timber sealing
author: Bouul Carpentry Team
problemHeadline: Unsealed timber decks warp, splinter, and rot under harsh South African sun
problemBody: Sub-standard deck joists built on bare soil sink and collapse within 2 seasons.
bouulSolution: Engineering-backed substructure framing using CCA treated pine joists on concrete footings
Hardwood Balau, Garapa, or Thermo-treated pine decking boards with hidden fasteners
Escrow protection released after structure load-testing and protective oiling
partsNeeded: Hidden deck fastener clips & stainless screws
aiPromptExample: Quote wooden deck: '25m² outdoor deck around pool area using Balau hardwood.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Area: 25m². Substructure: CCA Treated Pine. Decking: 19x90mm Balau. Escrow Quote: R38,000.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after final inspection of joist spacing and deck oil application.
pirbStandard: ITC-SA Timber Decking Code of Practice & SANS 10082.

articleSections.heading: CCA Treated Substructure Protection
articleSections.body: Joists are elevated off damp soil on concrete pads and coated with bituminous sealant.

articleSections.heading: Hidden Fastener Finish
articleSections.body: Decking boards are secured using hidden clips for a smooth, screw-free surface underfoot.

title: Wooden & Composite Countertop Installation
subtitle: Precision cutting and joining for wooden butcher-block and composite kitchen tops
author: Bouul Carpentry Team
problemHeadline: Uneven countertop joints harbor bacteria and warp when exposed to sink water
problemBody: Cutting sink cutout holes without proper support leads to cracked or splintered countertops.
bouulSolution: Expert carpenter cuts sink and hob openings with waterproof edge sealing
Seamless mason's mitre joints using Worktop connecting bolts and waterproof glue
Escrow released after sink fitment and food-safe oiling
aiPromptExample: Book countertop install: 'Fit 3.6m solid oak butcher block kitchen countertop with sink cutout.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: 2x Mason mitre joins, 1x Undermount sink cutout, 1x Hob cutout. Escrow Quote: R2,800.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after checking joint tightness and waterproof seal.

articleSections.heading: Waterproof Cutout Sealing
articleSections.body: All sink and tap cutouts are sealed with two coats of marine polyurethane to prevent water ingress.

articleSections.heading: Mason's Mitre Precision
articleSections.body: Worktops are joined using routed mason mitre joints pulled tight with underside draw-bolts.

title: Skirting Board & Architectural Moulding Installation
subtitle: Precision mitred skirting board, architrave, and decorative cornice fitting
author: Bouul Carpentry Team
problemHeadline: Gapping skirting corners and sloppy joints ruin the look of newly laid flooring
problemBody: Walls in SA homes are rarely 90° straight, causing standard 45° mitre joints to open up.
bouulSolution: Professional carpenter copes inside corners and bisects angle mitres for seamless fits
Installation of MDF, hardwood, or pine skirting boards with hidden masonry fixings
Escrow holds funds until all joints are filled and sanded flush
aiPromptExample: Quote skirting install: 'Install 45 meters of 140mm white MDF skirting boards in living rooms.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Length: 45m. Material: 140mm Ogee MDF. Joints: Coped internal, mitred external. Escrow Quote: R3,600.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after joint inspection and flush filling.

articleSections.heading: Coped Inside Corners
articleSections.body: Inside corners are coped rather than simple-mitred, ensuring joints stay tight even if walls settle.

articleSections.heading: Masonry Anchor Technique
articleSections.body: Skirtings are secured using dual fixings — masonry drive anchors and high-tack adhesive.

title: Wooden Staircase, Tread & Balustrade Repair
subtitle: Fixing squeaky steps, loose handrails, and damaged timber treads
author: Bouul Carpentry Team
problemHeadline: Creaking stair treads and loose balustrades pose a serious family fall risk
problemBody: Worn stair treads weaken over time, while wobbling handrails fail to support body weight.
bouulSolution: Structural repair of stair stringers, replacement of damaged treads, and tight balustrade anchoring
Elimination of tread squeaks using underside wedge blocking and structural adhesive
Escrow released after load-testing handrails and squeak-free walk test
partsNeeded: Pneumatic pin nailer & pocket hole jig
aiPromptExample: Book stair repair: 'Fix 4 squeaky wooden treads and re-anchor loose staircase balustrade.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Re-wedge 4 treads from underside, anchor new heavy-duty handrail bracket. Escrow: R1,800.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after testing handrail firmness and tread silence.

articleSections.heading: Underside Wedge Blocking
articleSections.body: Squeaks are eliminated by driving glued hardwood wedges into the tread-riser joints from below.

articleSections.heading: Balustrade Load Anchoring
articleSections.body: Handrails are anchored into solid wall studs using heavy-duty steel mounting brackets.
